Свето писмо или Библија Превод Даничић-Караџић, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/srp1868/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation):
> "Public Domain
Language: српски (Serbian)
Овај превод Библије је у јавном власништву (није заштићен ауторским правима)."
(from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/srp1868/copyright.htm)

Why this is public domain:
Translators: Vuk Stefanović Karadžić, 1787-1864 (New Testament, first published in Vienna in 1847); Đuro Daničić, 1825-1882 (Old Testament, published in Belgrade in 1867, died in Zagreb in 1882). The two were combined and printed together in 1868 (per English Wikipedia's Serbian Bible article, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbian_Bible). US: published 1847 to 1868, before 1931, so public domain in the United States. Origin country: Serbia (publication in Vienna and Belgrade). Both translators died long enough ago that their works are public domain under any term from 50 to 70 years: Karadžić in 1864 and Daničić in 1882. Both translators died in 1882 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 140 years or less, whatever the exact rule of Serbia or Austria.

Sources of these facts:
eBible.org copyright page (https://ebible.org/srp1868/copyright.htm); life dates from English Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vuk_Karad%C5%BEi%C4%87 and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C4%90ura_Dani%C4%8Di%C4%87) and the publication history from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serbian_Bible.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-srp1868-d4f520bc, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
